blocks.text: Sulfur -2, 0, +2, +4 aur +6 oxidation states dikhati hai. Us ki electronic configuration (Figure 12.8) dikhati hai ke oxidation state unpaired electrons ki tadaad se tay hoti hai: do unpaired 3p electrons ke saath sulfur -2 ya +2 hai; ek 3p electron ko 3d orbital mein promote karne se chaar unpaired electrons aur +4; saath 3s electron bhi promote karne se chhe aur +6. Standard halaat mein sulfur aur oxygen react kar ke sulfur dioxide dete hain, jis mein sulfur +4 hai; sulfur trioxide, sulfur +6 ke saath, banane ko zyada energy chahiye.

blocks.alt: Chaar qataron mein orbital box khaake. Oxygen, 2s2 2p4, ke do unpaired electrons hain aur 2d orbitals nahi, is liye promotion mumkin nahi. Ground state sulfur, 3s2 3p4, ke do unpaired electrons (-2 ya +2). Pehli excited state, 3s2 3p3 3d1, mein aik 3p electron 3d mein gaya, chaar (+4). Doosri excited state, 3s1 3p3 3d2, mein aik 3s electron bhi gaya, chhe (+6).

blocks.prompt: SO3, H2SO4, SO4 2- aur S2O3 2- mein S ki oxidation state nikalein, aur mukhtalif oxidation states mein d orbitals ka kirdar wazeh karein (Quick Check 12.4a, c).
blocks.explanation: SO3: S + 3(-2) = 0, +6. H2SO4: 2(+1) + S + 4(-2) = 0, +6. SO4 2-: S - 8 = -2, +6. S2O3 2-: 2S - 6 = -2, ausat +2. Sulfur ke khali 3d orbitals ek 3p electron (chaar unpaired, +4) ya saath 3s electron bhi (chhe unpaired, +6) promote hone dete hain, to sulfur chaar ya chhe bonds bana sakti hai, jo nitrogen aur oxygen, bina d orbitals ke, nahi kar sakte.

items: States -2, 0, +2, +4, +6 3d mein promotion ke baad unpaired electrons ki tadaad se; S + O2 aasani se SO2 (+4) deta hai; SO3 (+6) ko zyada energy chahiye.
